```plato

    //==
    // # Ray - triangle
    //
    // Moller-Trumbore: solve the ray/triangle system directly for the barycentric
    // pair and the distance, with no precomputed plane
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Moller-Trumbore_intersection_algorithm).
    // The determinant is the scalar triple product of the two edge vectors and the
    // ray direction, so it vanishes exactly when the ray is parallel to the
    // triangle's plane. Backfaces are NOT culled: a hit is reported whichever side
    // the ray arrives from.

    // The unnormalized barycentric-and-distance solution of the ray/triangle system,
    // as (determinant, u, v, t). Meaningful only where the determinant is non-zero;
    // the containment and forward-facing tests are TriangleHit's, not this one's.
    MollerTrumbore(r: Ray3D, t: Triangle3D): Number4
    {
        var e1 = t.A.Between(t.B);
        var e2 = t.A.Between(t.C);
        var p = r.Direction.Vector.Cross(e2);
        var det = e1.Dot(p);
        var s = t.A.Between(r.Origin);
        var q = s.Cross(e1);
        return (det, s.Dot(p), r.Direction.Vector.Dot(q), e2.Dot(q));
    }
```
